I was married in the year 1969. 2.The Mehar was fixed for Rs 35,000.00 (thirty five thousand only). 3.The payment terms were as below ( a ) half mehar was Mawaj-jal ( b ) half mehar was Mauj-jal. 4. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 30583 Country: India Title: I would like to know solution to the following mas'ala under the light of Qur'anul Kareem and Ahadithun Nabavi sallallah alaihiwasallam. A couple got married (Nikah) long ago (say 40 years ago) with a MEHR of certain amount for example Rs. 5000/-. Till date he has not paid the MEHR. Now he wants to pay the MEHR to his wife. The mas'alah is should he pay the MEHR of Rs. 5000/- or any other way. Question: Assalamu alaikum. I would like to know solution to the following mas'ala under the light of Qur'anul Kareem and Ahadithun Nabavi sallallah alaihiwasallam. A couple got married (Nikah) long ago (say 40 years ago) with a MEHR of certain amount for example Rs. 5000/-. Till date he has not paid the MEHR. Now he wants to pay the MEHR to his wife. The mas'alah is should he pay the MEHR of Rs. 5000/- or any other way. Answer ID: 30583 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 391/391/M=1432) In the question mentioned above, only the payment of five thousand is necessary on husband. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
